title: 36 Hours in Jackson Hole, Wyo.
abstract: Expansive wilderness, superlative skiing and a top-notch food scene await visitors to this charming, idiosyncratic town and valley.

title: 36 Hours in Cork, Ireland (and Beyond)
abstract: Don’t overlook Ireland’s second city, with its many churches, pubs, local beers and an increasingly diverse array of restaurants.

title: 36 Hours in Manchester, England
abstract: A visit here becomes an exercise in peeling back layers of sooty, hard-working history to arrive at a shinier, bustling and hopeful present.

title: 36 Hours in Vienna
abstract: Far from just a time capsule of imperial palaces and fin-de-siècle flourishes, this multicultural metropolis of 1.8 million has long been at the crossroads of cultures.
